## Power Sessions 0.1.4

The Sessions list now highlights the tab Orca shows, and showing a tab and compacting a chat work again on Orca 1.4.259.

- The session Orca shows is highlighted live. Before, the highlight could lag by many minutes and mark the wrong session.
- The project and workspace Orca shows are highlighted too.
- No session is highlighted while Orca shows a file, browser or other non-session tab.
- Showing a tab, compacting a chat and the highlight work on Orca 1.4.259, which moved an internal file the plugin uses. Older Orca builds keep working.
- A failed Orca call shows a one-line reason instead of a long script.

No new plugin capabilities. Updates install without re-approval.
